tool_gap.reason: The cap cannot be seen on this server. Carve 800206 ticks every 250 ms over 2500 ms (class contract periodic(0, 250), AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp:163-170, DurationIndex 66), so a channel has at most 10 ticks; the dodge amount is clamped to 10 ticks (AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:42) and the end clamp sets 10 ticks (AscensionFelswornAuras.cpp:224-227). A server without the clamp reads the same 9 at 2400 ms and 10 at the end. Haste scales period and duration together and cannot add ticks. First design (fw-b3g2r3): a duration mutant; the harness generator offers spell_mod_mutant for forced rolls only. Second design (fw-l2, completed by fw-l2b): a scan of every Spell.dbc row of the server DBC set for aura 107/108 with MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) or 22, family 20 and a class mask on Carve's SpellFamilyFlags[2] 2097152 finds only Quick Carving 520254: Effect[0] ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_DURATION -1000 ms and Effect[1] ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME -40% (BasePoints -41 + 1), which AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic applies to the tick period (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:725). Together: 2500 - 1000 = 1500 ms at 250 x 0.6 = 150 ms, still 10 ticks. The class contracts add no duration or period modifier to Carve. No obtainable state gives Carve an eleventh tick, so the 10% cap can never bind in play; the clamp is read in code only.

reason: Status 3 shape (guide section 2, G-24): two agents with different designs found no behaviour route, and the reason above shows the cap cannot bind in play; not status 4, because nothing here is client-only.
